name: Ritesh Firodiya
title: Ritesh Firodiya — Engineer who ships
headline: Engineer who ships.
tagline: ~9 years across web, mobile, and backend. Now building my own products for India — web and mobile — and agent tooling on Anthropic SDK + MCP.
about: I'm a full-stack engineer and lead with about nine years shipping production TypeScript across React, Next.js, React Native, and NestJS. Most recently, I spent a year as a Senior Engineer at Walmart on internal revenue tooling — wrapped up May 2026.

Before that I ran short-term contract engagements (TopLegal as Tech Lead, ManifestIT, Speechify), and held senior IC roles at Masai, Swiggy, Globant, and Confluxsys. I move comfortably across the stack — Postgres schema, GraphQL APIs, React/RN UI, EAS releases — and I've shipped solo on monorepos using Turborepo + Yarn workspaces.
Right now I'm building a handful of products on the side and going deep on agent-based developer tooling with the Anthropic SDK and MCP.
currently: Open to senior / staff IC and tech-lead roles. Always up to chat about engineering, product, and AI tooling.
summary: Full-stack engineer and lead with ~9 years shipping production TypeScript across React, Next.js, React Native, and NestJS. Comfortable end-to-end — Postgres schema to Play Store release. Currently building AI-assisted developer tooling on Anthropic SDK + MCP.

experiences.description: Built and shipped on an internal revenue management system across web and mobile. Worked end-to-end across React, React Native, TypeScript, and Node.
Led architecture and delivery of a contract management platform. Owned GraphQL schema design, DynamoDB modeling, and team direction during the engagement.
Built complex UI workflows for a CMDB management tool in Next.js, integrating against backend services and shipping iteratively with the team.
Worked on a multiplatform TTS SDK and the Dubbing Studio — a video-translation product. Full-stack across Svelte components and GraphQL APIs.
Took multiple applications from idea to production with full delivery ownership. Mentored junior engineers across React, Node, GraphQL, Prisma, and AWS.
Shipped consumer-app features in React/TypeScript/Node. Worked on auth and ticketing modules; partnered with PM/QA on production triage.
Web applications for banking and auditing clients. Pixel-accurate UI work in React, integrating backend systems via Node.
Full-stack engineer at a startup. Shipped frontend, backend, and database work with end-to-end delivery ownership.

projects.name: Chitragupt (चित्रगुप्त)
projects.tagline: Household tax review for salaried Indian filers
projects.description: Upload Form 16 and see your tax under both regimes side by side, run a 15-question Quick Check, and print the refund you can claim or the deductions you can still use. Free, with a household lens that covers spouse, parents and kids. Next.js on Cloud Run over roughly 189 Firebase Functions, with Zod schemas as the shared contract.

projects.name: Learning Platform
projects.tagline: LMS where course content is code
projects.description: A learning platform where courses are authored as markdown in a Git repository and synced into the product on push, so content review happens in pull requests. NestJS and Apollo on the backend, Next.js on the front, Prisma over Postgres.

projects.name: Charades — Act it Out!
projects.description: A charades party game with 5,149 cards across Bollywood, Tollywood, Hollywood and Family & Kids. Fully offline with no daily limits. Live on the Play Store at 1.0.30, with a public TestFlight beta on iOS.

projects.name: Tic Tac Toe — 2 Player XO
projects.description: Two players on one device, or a minimax AI that plays perfectly on Hard. Live on the Play Store with a public TestFlight beta on iOS.

projects.name: Imposter: Find the Liar
projects.tagline: Social deduction for 3–20 people on one phone
projects.description: Most players see a secret word. The Imposter sees only a one-word hint, hand-written for every single word. Mr. White sees nothing and can still steal the round. Three categories free forever, the other seven are one payment — no ads and no analytics in the project at all.

projects.name: Aakalan (आकलन)
projects.tagline: Your expenses and everyone else's, on one ledger
projects.description: Track what you spend on your own, split anything with friends, flatmates and colleagues, and settle up over UPI without leaving the app. iOS beta is open to anyone via TestFlight; Android is in closed testing.

projects.name: AskCal
projects.tagline: AI calorie counter that admits what it can't see
projects.description: Every camera-first calorie app turns a photo into one confident number, but a photo cannot show the oil a dish was cooked in. AskCal marks each value Seen, Guessed or Unknown, resolves against USDA data, and asks one or two questions instead of guessing. In review on the Play closed track. No iOS build has been uploaded yet, so there is no TestFlight to join.

projects.name: Scrvio
projects.description: Record screen, camera and audio straight from the browser with no install and no sign-up, then keep recordings in your own S3 bucket rather than a vendor's cloud. Team workspaces, shareable links with expiry, and Stripe-backed per-seat billing.

projects.name: Trunk
projects.tagline: Product development where every change is a delta
projects.description: One platform replacing the stack most product teams cobble together: deltas instead of Jira, documentation instead of Notion, signals instead of Segment and Sentry, and feature flags instead of LaunchDarkly — all against the same change record.

projects.name: DwarSeva — Societies
projects.description: A modular society management system covering visitor check-ins, community events, service requests, payments and staff attendance. Backend, web admin and mobile share one Turborepo with NestJS, GraphQL and Prisma at the core.

projects.name: DwarSeva — Property
projects.description: Property search on a map, with a prepaid wallet and a universal ₹5-per-action friction filter so only serious enquiries get through. Every listing is verified by a human. Separate codebase from the society platform.

projects.name: tradx
projects.tagline: India-focused trading research and paper trading
projects.description: A unified control centre for trading research and paper trading on Indian markets. Ships paper-only by default — live order routing stays gated behind an explicit flag until the research, risk, approval and broker paths are each verified independently.

projects.name: Plan-Kid
projects.tagline: Parenthood journey app for couples in India
projects.description: From the pre-decision stage through to parenting, across Knowledge, Journal, Motivation and Tracking. Design and product stage.

education.institution: P.V.G. College of Engineering and Technology
